requirements.judgement: Random motion and net movement distinguished; no directed intention or ATP requirement inferred.
Correct substance-specific inward oxygen/outward carbon-dioxide gradients; continued consumption maintains gradient.
Water-potential definition includes selective membrane; dilute/concentrated shortcut correctly conditioned on solute retention and pressure.
Plant-wall support, turgor and plasmolysis distinguished from animal swelling/lysis and shrinkage; outcomes qualified.
Against-gradient mineral uptake linked to protein and energy; no claim oxygen absence instantly eliminates all ATP.
Dialysis model supports selective permeability/passive diffusion only; controls prevent an unsupported active-transport inference.
Gradient effect qualified with comparable other variables, continual two-way motion and closed-system equilibrium.
Shorter path lowers diffusion distance; no invented exact inverse-rate law.
Temperature increases kinetic energy in the simple model; damage limits living-tissue extrapolation.
All worked cube areas/volumes and inverse-length units independently recalculated; total surface distinguished from surface per volume.
L−2d core edge and cubic volume fraction independently recalculated:48.8% and27.1% for the supplied model; indicator front not literal particle speed.
Agar plan includes exposed faces, repeated sizes, fixed acid/time/temperature, safe handling and uncertainty/model limits.
Potato plan identifies IV/DV, same tissue/dimensions/time/volume/temperature/blotting and repeated initial/final masses.
Signed initial-baseline changes +9% and−12% checked independently; mass observation distinguished from osmosis inference.
Dialysis known-mixture tests use separate start/end samples, blank/positive controls, leak inspection and rinsing; Benedict test not glucose-specific.
Solute/membrane/time-specific permeability and detection limits explicit; models omit living proteins and cannot establish universal absorption mechanism.
Non-living osmosis plan checks actual solute retention, equal-pressure initial direction and equal-concentration control; no unsupported assumption about sucrose tubing.
Invented repeats give means9,3,−2,−9%; interpolation0.32mol/dm³ independently checked and labelled estimate; ±0.02g difference uncertainty correctly bounded.
